two_maps_measured.instructions: Are there two fresh RAM receipts (1A-90-ram and 1A-90-ram2) on two different 2-player maps of at most 30x30, both on the current revision?

criteria.true: Two valid receipts on different maps.
criteria.false: Missing, same map, or stale revision.

soak_reported.instructions: Does the Result or state.ram_history_all_cards include the 1A-12 soak result with RAM growth per hour ≤ 50 MB?

criteria.true: Soak result is present and within the limit.
